core.title: Mortise Privacy Leverset w/Occupancy Indicator, AHI SIG152/AM39/200/252/272TT-P22

text.description_html:
AHI Stainless Steel Mortise Privacy Leverset w/Occupancy Indicator

Mortise Lockcase: Heavy gauge plated steel for custom residential, high traffic commercial, institutional and industrial uses where durability is the greatest concern.

Specifications:

  • Function: Privacy, Panic Proof
  • Mortise Case Faceplate: 1-1/4" Stainless steel
  • Latch Bolt: Brass anti-friction type
  • Deadbolt: Forged brass with hardened steel inserts
  • Backset: 2 3/4" (70mm)
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Strike plate: Stainless steel ANSI standard 4-7/8" x 1-1/4" x 1-1/8" lip to center
  • Door Levers: AHI SIG152 Levers
  • Trim Roses: SIG200 52MM Diameter
  • Occupancy Indicator: SIG252 (Shows Red/White)
  • Lock Thumb Turn: SIG272 ADA Compliant
  • Solid Stainless Steel Trim
  • Finish: PVD P22 Matte Black
  • Handing: RHR, Right Hand Outswing



*Made to order item. Please allow 8 weeks to ship.

**Not Returnable.
